name: perspective.delete
title: Delete perspective
summary: Delete a perspective after confirmation; without confirm the output names its name and file and nothing is deleted.
details: Without `confirm` nothing is deleted: the output names the name stored in the file, the file and its fileSha256, which a call with `confirm` deletes. Every call checks everything again; nothing is kept between calls. Give `file` and `expectedFileSha256` from the call without `confirm`, so the confirmed call deletes only that file with those bytes. The folder stays, also when it is empty afterwards. When another file of the folder has the same name, it holds the name once the file is deleted: a warning in `problems`; remove such a file by hand when it is not wanted. file.faulty when only a faulty file holds the name (details.files); file.folder-missing when the repository of the perspectives folder is not on this machine (details.repository). Errors: input.invalid at `name` when no perspective has it; file.changed-on-disk when another file holds the name than `file`, when the file has other bytes than `expectedFileSha256`, or when it changed while the call ran; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder for a place in Git (D-036); file.read-only when the file or its folder is not writable. Nothing is deleted on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-217 AK7: deleting is refused while ReqSeq refuses write commands (SR-011 AK3).

name.description: The perspective to delete, by its name in any case or Unicode normal form.

confirm.description: Delete the file; without it nothing is deleted and the output names what `confirm` deletes.

file.description: The file the call without `confirm` named, relative to the workspace root: refused with file.changed-on-disk when another file holds the name now.

expectedFileSha256.description: The fileSha256 the call without `confirm` gave: refused with file.changed-on-disk when the file has other bytes now.

name.title: Perspective
name.description: The name stored in the file of the perspective.

file.title: File
file.description: Its file, relative to the workspace root.

fileSha256.title: File SHA-256
fileSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file as read, for `expectedFileSha256`.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: Whether the file was deleted: true only with `confirm`.

files.title: Files
files.description: The deleted file, relative to the workspace root; empty when nothing was deleted.
